title: Design System: 项目管理系统

headline.purpose: Application title and major page heading only.

title.purpose: Panel headings and major section titles.

body.purpose: Tables, cards, forms, and detail content.

label.purpose: Field labels and compact control labels.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and simple state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Committed action button for create, save, submit, and confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #1f6f5b; background: #1f6f5b; color: #fff; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 14px/1.45 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #155443; border-color: #155443; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31,111,91,.34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Utility button for refresh, open folder, cancel, and secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #b9c3cf; background: #fff; color: #17202a; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 14px/1.45 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #eef2f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31,111,91,.34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #b42318; background: #b42318; color: #fff; padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 6px; font: 700 14px/1.45 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #8f1d14; border-color: #8f1d14; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(180,35,24,.34); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text, date, and select field vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #344054; font: 600 13px/1.35 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #b9c3cf; background: #fff; color: #17202a; padding: 7px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.45 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(31,111,91,.34); border-color: #1f6f5b; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact status marker with text plus semantic color.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef2f6; color: #465466; font: 700 12px/1.35 Microsoft YaHei, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-warning { background: #fff2d8; color: #a15c00; } .ds-chip-success { background: #e9f3ef; color: #155443; } .ds-chip-danger { background: #fff0ef; color: #b42318; }

narrative.overview: This interface is a working ledger for project facts and execution state. It should feel clear, disciplined, and practical.
keyCharacteristics: Dense but ordered information for repeated daily use.
Clear separation between project facts and execution process.
Status and risk are visible through text plus color.
Destructive and recovery-sensitive actions are visually distinct.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Operational Green is for current selection and committed action only. Do not use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Status Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every warning, risk, success, or pending state must include text, not just color.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Product screens use fixed rem/px scale, not fluid hero typography.

rules.name: The Flat Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Task cards, table rows, and filters stay flat. If every item casts a shadow, nothing is important.

dos: Do keep the UI quiet, utilitarian, and work-focused.
Do show the next operational decision first.
Do keep destructive actions red and recovery-sensitive.
Do preserve the separation between project facts and execution process.
donts: Don't make this look like a marketing website, landing page, SaaS hero page, or decorative dashboard.
Don't use oversized hero sections or promotional copy.
Don't use excessive cards, nested cards, decorative shadows, or visual noise.
Don't use dense unstructured tables that expose everything at once without priority.
Don't make engineers fill unnecessary fields before they can update real work state.
